```artifact
Feature: Update Doctor and Lab Information
  As an admin
  I want to update doctor and lab information
  So that the system has the latest information

  Scenario: Update Doctor Information
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the doctor's profile is created
    When the admin updates the doctor's information
    Then the doctor's profile is updated successfully

  Scenario: Update Lab Information
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the lab's profile is created
    When the admin updates the lab's information
    Then the lab's profile is updated successfully

  Scenario: Update Chemist Information
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the chemist's profile is created
    When the admin updates the chemist's information
    Then the chemist's profile is updated successfully

  Scenario: Update Patient Information
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient's profile is created
    When the patient updates their information
    Then the patient's profile is updated successfully

  Scenario: Create Appointment
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the doctor's profile is created
    When the patient creates an appointment
    Then the appointment is created successfully

  Scenario Outline: Update Doctor Information with Different Fields
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the doctor's profile is created
    When the admin updates the doctor's <field> to <value>
    Then the doctor's profile is updated successfully
    Examples:
      | field        | value      |
      | name         | John Doe   |
      | specialty    | Cardiology |
      | phone_number | 1234567890 |

  Scenario Outline: Update Lab Information with Different Fields
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the lab's profile is created
    When the admin updates the lab's <field> to <value>
    Then the lab's profile is updated successfully
    Examples:
      | field        | value      |
      | name         | Lab X      |
      | address      | 123 Main St|
      | phone_number | 9876543210 |

  Scenario Outline: Update Chemist Information with Different Fields
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the chemist's profile is created
    When the admin updates the chemist's <field> to <value>
    Then the chemist's profile is updated successfully
    Examples:
      | field        | value      |
      | name         | Chemist Y  |
      | address      | 456 Elm St |
      | phone_number | 5551234567 |

  Scenario Outline: Update Patient Information with Different Fields
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient's profile is created
    When the patient updates their <field> to <value>
    Then the patient's profile is updated successfully
    Examples:
      | field        | value      |
      | name         | Jane Doe   |
      | email        | jane@example.com |
      | phone_number | 5555555555 |

  Scenario Outline: Create Appointment with Different Fields
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the doctor's profile is created
    When the patient creates an appointment with <field> as <value>
    Then the appointment is created successfully
    Examples:
      | field        | value      |
      | date         | 2023-03-01 |
      | time         | 10:00 AM  |
      | description  | Appointment description |
```
